summary: Extracts gzip and ZIP archive members under decompression budgets. Also provides check_zip_container, which bounds an untrusted ZIP container's actual inflated size and member count, and rejects ambiguous directories, before a third-party reader opens it.
lifecycle_notes: Hardening against zip bombs and directory forgery; the ZIP check is shared with the XLSX reader.
documentation_hooks: Security note: decompression limits and zip-bomb defence
Archive member selection: file_pattern, sort_order, on_unrecognised
risks: Security-sensitive parser of untrusted binary structure; each guard in _declared_entries closes a reader-disagreement bypass.
unpack_archive returns complete members in memory; the budget bounds total size but there is no per-member streaming.
open_questions: The archive exception classes are not exported from the package root, so callers cannot catch them without a private import.
